row.body: The home inspection marks every room clear, but the key return sheet leaves one bedroom assigned to a visitor.
row.title: The charming address

sidecar.gloss: A room is listed for a visitor after the home is marked clear.
sidecar.rival_reading: A contractor could have used the room during inspection; the sheet does not establish who was inside.

row.body: the spool of thread and first-aid kit carry the same black paint. a fresh scrape exposes an older evacuation color beneath.
row.title: missing count beside the spool of thread

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
